description: National Road Condition Database is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Transport. National Road Condition Database. Measurements of road surface condition of roads taken from local authority SCANNER (Surface Condition Assessment for the Nationals Network of Roads). These machine surveys are carried our carried out using accredited SCANNER vehicles. The data is gathered from contractors by TRL (Transport Research Laboratory). Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Transport. The portal shows 2013-12-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
